title: Gate width yields a normal-form width bound
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, let $w$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $G$ be an AND or OR gate. If $f$ has width at most $w$ in the normal form associated with $G$, then $f$ has width at most $w$ in DNF or in CNF.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the n-dimensional sign cube
Choice of an AND or OR gate
Width-at-most-w representation in the normal form associated with the gate
